groups.title: Recruiters
groups.hint: Recruiters who hire students. Look for “university”, “campus” or “early careers” in the headline.

items.label: University recruiter
items.hint: Owns intern hiring; the best first contact.

items.label: Technical recruiter
items.hint: Check the headline mentions interns or new grads.

items.label: Campus recruiting
items.hint: Runs career fairs and info sessions.

groups.title: People on the team
groups.hint: Engineers doing similar work. Prefer people a year or two out of school.

items.label: Firmware
items.hint: Look for the same team or product in their experience.

groups.title: Alumni from your school
groups.hint: People who went to your school. Shared background makes a reply more likely.

items.label: University of Northfield alumni
items.hint: Use the “School” filter on LinkedIn for University of Northfield.

groups.title: Google searches
groups.hint: Public pages, for when LinkedIn search is limited.

items.label: Recruiter profiles
items.hint: Public LinkedIn profiles that mention the company and role.

items.label: Firmware profiles
items.hint: Public profiles of people with this kind of role.

items.label: Engineering blog
items.hint: Recent posts make a good, specific opener.
